# SCI-VAL v0.1 — Stage B Revision Directive r0.2

not frozen

`bcae1466e5d28bc32d950822f2ebc1c8f848466062761ccc3216b3e708c923f2`

## Preserved Scientific Core

The four-axis model, open-world fact semantics, structural gate,
false-dominant disposition algebra, cause preservation, exact/conservative
influence distinction, nonretroactivity, aggregation interchange, and worked
finite-retained-replaced occurrence remain the scientific foundation.

## Owner-Approved Revision Decisions

| Decision | Approved disposition |
| --- | --- |
| `VAL-R02-D001` | Split the authority conceptually into SCI-VAL Core and an owner-bound Profile Registry. Core owns shared types and deterministic evaluation mechanics. The registry records immutable bindings; neither layer authors a scientific-use policy. |
| `VAL-R02-D002` | Every usable registry entry binds the actual scientific owner, authoritative source, exact version/digest, applicability domain, restrictions, exception permissions, compatibility rules, and unavailable behavior. Registration never transfers policy authority to VAL. |
| `VAL-R02-D003` | `independent_exposure` is the first mandatory canonical registered profile. Direct representative synthesis or replacement is a contract-level invariant for this profile and is not exceptionable. A profile that attempts such an override is invalid and cannot produce eligibility. |
| `VAL-R02-D004` | Base v0.1 aggregation is homogeneous in exact profile identity and version, lifecycle stage, object type, and applicability domain. Heterogeneous aggregation is unavailable unless an explicit owner-approved transformation policy defines one common aggregate proposition. |
| `VAL-R02-D005` | Detector-to-occurrence or other reverse propagation creates a new lifecycle generation. A propagated aggregate cannot rewrite the decisions in its own denominator or participate circularly in the same aggregation generation. |
| `VAL-R02-D006` | Rename the broad MAP-facing use to `map_upstream_admission`. Package-specific fitting, application, output, coefficient/QC, response, empirical/simulation, and diagnostic uses receive package-qualified profile names. A name alone remains non-authoritative. |
| `VAL-R02-D007` | Bind imported RTC, CAL, PTC, and MAP meanings to exact approved package or boundary sources. An unavailable MAP policy remains unavailable; the register must not manufacture one. |
| `VAL-R02-D008` | Render a distinct seven-to-nine-page scientist-facing rationale with the worked occurrence table on page 2 and plain-language diagrams. Keep tuples, truth tables, equations, all requirements/predictions, replay, and conformance obligations in the engineering specification. |
| `VAL-R02-D009` | Preserve `SCI-VAL-REQ-001--042` and `SCI-VAL-PRED-001--018` by ID. Correct wording where needed and append new identifiers only. Audit overloaded notation. |

## Authority Boundary

The owner emphasized the controlling sentence:

> VAL remains the evaluator and registry mechanism—not the policy author.

This revision therefore may define registry integrity, profile identity,
compatibility, policy validity, and deterministic execution. It may not
invent a PTC, MAP, RTC, CAL, or other consumer predicate, threshold,
exception, aggregation, or production default.

## Claim Limit

This directive authorizes document revision only. It does not establish
implementation conformity, observational validation, scientific freeze,
production readiness, or adjacent-package readiness.
